quote: The driver of a vehicle approaching an intersection shall yield the right-of-way to a vehicle which has entered the intersection from a different highway. Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4], this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn.

activation.condition: the subject is approaching an intersection; another vehicle has already entered the intersection from a different highway; the intersection is not controlled by official traffic-control devices

obligation.description: The driver of a vehicle approaching an intersection shall yield the right-of-way to a vehicle which has entered the intersection from a different highway. Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4], this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn.

exceptions.trigger: intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices, unless the signal is inoperative (the subsection-4 case)
exceptions.effect: preserve clause scope; no additional exception inferred
exceptions.source_clause: intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices, unless the signal is inoperative (the subsection-4 case)

exceptions.trigger: vehicles approaching from opposite directions where one is making or intending a left turn
exceptions.effect: preserve clause scope; no additional exception inferred
exceptions.source_clause: vehicles approaching from opposite directions where one is making or intending a left turn

timing.description: the other vehicle's entry precedes the subject's; that order is the whole test; the duty lasts while the other vehicle is in the intersection

judgment_calls_needed.note: Record precedence trajectories; no invented yielding distance or danger cutoff.
